scope.objective: Black-box check that a user can add participants and save results in the Decathlon & Heptathlon app (REQ-LOCAL-001 and REQ-LOCAL-002).

allowed_actions.limit: once per listed name, 5 in total per audit
at most 2 per audit, counting attempted saves

state_changes.constraints: State-changing checks are allowed only in the competition TP-TPT-20261106. The existing competitions General and TP-AUD-20261105-01 must not be changed.

scope.test_data_constraints: Local-only, disposable test data. No real personal data. Names start with TP-.
out_of_scope: The existing competitions General and TP-AUD-20261105-01
Server-side validation, performance and security testing
stop_conditions: Stop on an unexpected error, data loss, or any write outside the competition TP-TPT-20261106 (user, 2026-11-06)
Stop on a server error (5xx) response
Pause and ask when a check would need data or an action that the scope does not allow

requirements.title: A user can add a participant to a competition
requirements.acceptance_criteria: After entering a name and clicking 'Add competitor', the competitor is shown as a row in the standings table of the selected competition, and is still shown after a page reload.

requirements.title: A user can save a result for a participant
requirements.acceptance_criteria: For an existing competitor, selecting the event, entering a valid numeric result and clicking 'Save score' shows a success message without an error, and the competitor's row in the standings shows the result and the points for that event; the result is still shown after a page reload.

test_plan_items.title: Create the test competition and add TP-Anna (1440 px)
test_plan_items.preconditions: The app is reachable at http://localhost:8080. The competition TP-TPT-20261106 does not exist yet. Viewport 1440x900.
test_plan_items.test_data: Competition name TP-TPT-20261106, type Decathlon. Competitor name TP-Anna.
steps: Open http://localhost:8080 at viewport 1440x900.
Click 'New competition'.
Enter TP-TPT-20261106 as the competition name, keep the type Decathlon and click 'Create'.
Check that the competition TP-TPT-20261106 is selected.
Enter TP-Anna in the Name field under 'Add competitor' and click 'Add competitor'.
Check that a row for TP-Anna is shown in the Decathlon standings table and that no error is shown.
test_plan_items.acceptance_criteria: After entering a name and clicking 'Add competitor', the competitor is shown as a row in the standings table of the selected competition, and is still shown after a page reload.

test_plan_items.title: TP-Anna is still there after a page reload
test_plan_items.preconditions: The app is reachable at http://localhost:8080. TPI-001 is done: TP-Anna exists in the competition TP-TPT-20261106. Viewport 1440x900.
steps: Reload the page.
Select the competition TP-TPT-20261106 if it is not selected.
Check that a row for TP-Anna is shown in the Decathlon standings table.
test_plan_items.acceptance_criteria: After entering a name and clicking 'Add competitor', the competitor is shown as a row in the standings table of the selected competition, and is still shown after a page reload.

test_plan_items.title: Add TP-Bo and TP-Cia, three rows in total
test_plan_items.preconditions: The app is reachable at http://localhost:8080. TP-Anna exists in the competition TP-TPT-20261106, which is selected. Viewport 1440x900.

Enter TP-Cia in the Name field under 'Add competitor' and click 'Add competitor'.
Check that rows for TP-Anna, TP-Bo and TP-Cia are shown in the Decathlon standings table and that no error is shown.
test_plan_items.acceptance_criteria: After entering a name and clicking 'Add competitor', the competitor is shown as a row in the standings table of the selected competition, and is still shown after a page reload.

test_plan_items.title: Add a competitor with the keyboard only
test_plan_items.preconditions: The app is reachable at http://localhost:8080. The competition TP-TPT-20261106 exists and is selected. Viewport 1440x900. Heuristic-based (input method variation): the requirement has no keyboard criterion; the acceptance criterion is the one of the requirement.
steps: Move the focus to the Name field under 'Add competitor' with the Tab key.
Type TP-Key.
Move the focus to the 'Add competitor' button with the Tab key and press Enter.
Check that a row for TP-Key is shown in the Decathlon standings table and that no error is shown.
test_plan_items.acceptance_criteria: After entering a name and clicking 'Add competitor', the competitor is shown as a row in the standings table of the selected competition, and is still shown after a page reload.

test_plan_items.title: Save a valid 100m result for TP-Anna
test_plan_items.preconditions: The app is reachable at http://localhost:8080. TP-Anna exists in the competition TP-TPT-20261106, which is selected. Viewport 1440x900.
test_plan_items.test_data: Competitor TP-Anna, discipline Decathlon, event 100m, result 11.50.
steps: Select TP-Anna in the Competitor field under 'Enter result'.
Select the discipline Decathlon and the event 100m.
Enter 11.50 in the Result field and click 'Save score'.

Check that the row for TP-Anna shows the 100m result 11.50 and a points value.
test_plan_items.acceptance_criteria: For an existing competitor, selecting the event, entering a valid numeric result and clicking 'Save score' shows a success message without an error, and the competitor's row in the standings shows the result and the points for that event; the result is still shown after a page reload.

test_plan_items.title: The saved result is still there after a page reload
test_plan_items.preconditions: The app is reachable at http://localhost:8080. TPI-006 is done: TP-Anna has a 100m result of 11.50. Viewport 1440x900.
steps: Reload the page.
Select the competition TP-TPT-20261106 if it is not selected.
Check that the row for TP-Anna shows the 100m result 11.50 and a points value.
test_plan_items.acceptance_criteria: For an existing competitor, selecting the event, entering a valid numeric result and clicking 'Save score' shows a success message without an error, and the competitor's row in the standings shows the result and the points for that event; the result is still shown after a page reload.

test_plan_items.title: Save a Long Jump result, both events are shown
test_plan_items.preconditions: The app is reachable at http://localhost:8080. TP-Anna exists in the competition TP-TPT-20261106, which is selected, and has a 100m result. Viewport 1440x900.
test_plan_items.test_data: Competitor TP-Anna, discipline Decathlon, event Long Jump, result 680 (the app takes Long Jump in cm; 680 cm = 6.80 m).
steps: Select TP-Anna in the Competitor field under 'Enter result'.
Select the discipline Decathlon and the event Long Jump.
Enter 680 in the Result field and click 'Save score'.
Check that a success message is shown and no error is shown.
Check that the row for TP-Anna shows both the 100m result 11.50 and the Long Jump result 680 cm, each with a points value.
test_plan_items.acceptance_criteria: For an existing competitor, selecting the event, entering a valid numeric result and clicking 'Save score' shows a success message without an error, and the competitor's row in the standings shows the result and the points for that event; the result is still shown after a page reload.

executions.summary: Verified: the competition TP-TPT-20261106 (Decathlon) was created and selected (ACT-001); after adding TP-Anna a row 'TP-Anna' is shown in the Decathlon standings, the app says 'Added' and no error is shown. Not verified: console output for this item, blank or special-character names, server-side behaviour.
Verified: after a page reload the competition c2 is selected and the row 'TP-Anna' is still shown. Not verified: console output for this item, persistence in another browser or session.

Verified: after adding TP-Bo (ACT-003) and TP-Cia (ACT-004) the standings show three rows (TP-Anna, TP-Bo, TP-Cia) and no error. Not verified: console output for this item, ordering of equal rows, duplicate names.

Verified: at 375x812 TP-V375 was added (ACT-005) and a row 'TP-V375' is shown with no error. Observation, not judged because no requirement gives a layout criterion: the page is wider than the viewport (scrollWidth 383, clientWidth 360) and the standings table extends past it. Not verified: layout against any design reference, console output for this item.

Verified: with the keyboard only (Tab to the Name field, typing, Tab to the 'Add competitor' button with a visible focus, Enter) TP-Key was added (ACT-006) and a row 'TP-Key' is shown with no error. Not verified: other keyboard paths, screen reader behaviour; no automated accessibility scan was performed.

Verified: TP-Anna was chosen from the competitor list, Decathlon 100m 11.50 was saved (ACT-007); the app says 'Saved: 753 pts' with no error, and TP-Anna's row shows 753 points and the raw value 11.5 s for the 100m. Not verified: that 753 is the correct score (no scoring rule supplied), console output for this item, invalid values.

Verified: after a page reload competition c2 is selected and TP-Anna's row still shows 753 points and the raw value 11.5 s; the console had 0 messages since the load. Not verified: persistence in another browser or session.

Verified: TP-Anna was chosen from the competitor list, Decathlon Long Jump 680 cm was saved (ACT-008); the app says 'Saved: 767 pts' with no error, and TP-Anna's row shows both events: 100m 753 points (raw 11.5 s) and Long Jump 767 points (raw 680 cm), total 1520 (the sum of the two shown values); the console had 0 messages. Not verified: that 767 is the correct score (no scoring rule supplied), persistence of the Long Jump result after a reload, invalid values. The planned test data 6.80 was corrected to 680 cm because the app takes Long Jump in cm (see limitations).

coverage_gaps.description: Validation of competitor names (empty, duplicate, special characters, very long) is not verified: the requirement gives no criterion for it.
Validation of result values (empty, negative, non-numeric, unreasonably large) is not verified: the requirement gives no criterion for it.
Replacing an existing result and its confirmation dialog are not verified: the requirement gives no criterion for it.
Editing and removing a competitor are not verified: they are not part of the requirement and are not allowed by the scope.
Correctness of the points calculation and of the ranking per event is not verified: no scoring rule is supplied. The plan only checks that points are shown.
The CSV export of the results is not verified: the requirement gives no criterion for it.
Persistence of the Long Jump result after a page reload is not verified: TPI-007 reloaded the page before the Long Jump result was saved (TPI-008), and no later reload was planned.

limitations: 2026-11-06T13:19:21Z: Scope confirmed by the user (johan). It was proposed in the discover step and approved there; it is recorded here when the user approved the test plan.

2026-11-06T13:19:21Z: REQ-LOCAL-001 and REQ-LOCAL-002 come from the user's goal ('testa att man kan lägga till deltagare och spara resultat'). TestBench project 4 (TPT1106) has no requirements. The acceptance criteria were proposed by the agent and confirmed by the user when approving the test plan.

Execution start and finish times are derived from recorded tool timestamps and evidence read-out times; they are not measured to the second. The performed_at of an action is the time of the first tool record after the action.
Screenshot and console-log captured_at values are the file write times; the read-out files carry their own capture time.
The browser console was captured only after the page load of TPI-007 (EV-014). Console output of the other items was not captured.

A stale Chrome process (pid 82172, profile mcp-chrome-c6d51fd) from the earlier audit blocked the Playwright browser at the start of the run. It was ended with the user's approval before the first check; no check was affected.

2026-11-06T13:28:31Z: Correction confirmed by the user (johan) during the run: the app takes Long Jump in cm, so the planned test data 6.80 (TPI-008 and scope.state_changes save_result) was changed to 680 cm (= 6.80 m). It is the same intent; TPI-008 was run with 680.

No automated accessibility scan was performed in this audit. Accessibility signals were assessed through Playwright MCP exploration, keyboard interaction and DOM/accessibility-tree inspection. This does not establish WCAG 2.1 AA conformance.

Visual design review (step 4) was not run as a separate check: no requirement concerns visual presentation and no design reference exists. Responsive layout was observed in TPI-004 only (page wider than the 375 px viewport, see MTP-007).
No bug proposals were created, so no duplicate check was needed. No bug data is available from a TestBench integration for a comparison.
The expected values (753 and 767 points) were not compared with a scoring table; only that the app shows points was checked (see CG-005).
